description.value: Big Feast Bistro is a locally-celebrated small-town bistro with an urban atmosphere that opened in Maple Ridge in 2010 and was featured on the Food Network's 'You Gotta Eat Here.' The kitchen sources from over 50 local suppliers and hand-crafts its menu daily with a strong emphasis on gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan, and Ocean Wise seafood options. The bistro also operates a retail line of artisan small-batch products available in-house, making it a useful resupply stop for cyclists wanting to take local goods on the road.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 24m; rack at 27m; rack at 37m; rack at 50m; rack at 55m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is complete and detailed. The bistro explicitly confirms takeout (online ordering, group take-out menu), extensive vegetarian/vegan/GF menu options, and a patio where dogs are welcome. No mention of bike racks, bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging anywhere on the site. The phone number 604-477-4334 appears on multiple pages of the website, corroborating the OSM record which had no phone listed; address and website URL match OSM.
concerns: OSM record had no phone number; phone 604-477-4334 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone left null as there is nothing in OSM to corroborate against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, actively operating bistro with confirmed takeout and broad dietary accommodations (vegan, GF, vegetarian) that are directly relevant to touring cyclists; patio dining also noted. Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed but the food stop value is clear.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states menu focuses on gluten-free options, vegetarian and vegan choices, and Ocean Wise certified seafood; entire menu can be made gluten-free except stir-fry sauce; GF buns toasted on clean grill; keto options also available
